mapper.sql: id, author_id, title, summary, state, view_count, like_count, comment_count, favorite_count, publish_time, deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.author_id, a.title, a.summary, a.state, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.favorite_count, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM article_favorite f JOIN article a ON a.id = f.article_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND a.state = #{state} AND a.deleted = #{deleted} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.author_id, a.title, a.summary, a.state, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.favorite_count, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM column_article ca JOIN article a ON a.id = ca.article_id WHERE ca.column_id = #{columnId} AND a.state = #{state} AND a.deleted = #{deleted} ORDER BY ca.create_time ASC, ca.id ASC
